# ResearchOS

本仓库是独立 ResearchOS 产品，中文沟通。用户授权实现 `spec/v2.0/08_AGENT_EXECUTION_GOAL.md`，按难度选择子 Agent 模型。不得读取或继承其他业务项目的私有配置、身份、代码或部署。

## 唯一执行基线

- `spec/v2.0/`：原实施包逐字节只读快照；不得修改初始状态或验收阈值。
- `execution/project_identity.json`：永久项目身份。`execution/bootstrap_ledger.json`：施工状态，独立于产品业务状态。
- `execution/receipts/`：实际命令与产物回执；`execution/verifier/`：仅独立 Verifier 写入的施工审查。
- `execution/checkpoint.json`：续跑入口。按 `spec/v2.0/contracts/tasks.json` DAG，先核对 Git、身份、输入版本及有效回执。
- `bootstrap/`：开工导入与验证工具。W02 再由平台 owner 登记实际产品目录和命令。
- `.local/`：本仓库生成的工具、进程数据与可重建缓存，不入 Git；不得放正式唯一证据。

## 执行约束

默认最多 2 个活跃施工任务；使用独立 worktree 和唯一 owner/lease。共享合同、锁文件、路由和命令登记串行整合。主 Agent 负责整合与真实验证；执行者不签发自身接受回执。只读审查可使用当前仓库，不能把同用户的不同 Agent 当作受保护留出隔离。

模型策略：架构、安全、独立验收优先 `gpt-6-astra` 高推理；边界清晰的非平凡实现和施工复核用 `gpt-6-sol` 高推理；简单、低风险、可机械核验的独立工作用 `gpt-6-luna`。记录实际选择与理由，不创建用户侧新聊天，除非用户明确要求。

保留既有修改；不用 reset/clean 或 git add .。允许本地原子提交，不自动 push、部署、购买、充值或对外发消息。规格校验、开发夹具、真实服务和产品正式验收分开记录；未实现和零断言不得 PASS。只对新变化和未解决疑点补验。临时文件完成后删除，证据/检查点保留。

# DeepSeek Harness candidate intake — readonly

Verdict: useful as a **design reference for model-facing tool schema projection**, but there is no justified runtime library transplant. A narrow future pilot would add a pure, offline comparison of the frozen `model_config.tools` projection at the Mu worker boundary with the Go host's pinned schema/allowlist. It would have no new tool executor, terminal session, or authority. This is a proposed pilot only; no product code was changed.

Official source: `deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness` `master` at `5badb15009ae1756c3afe0ae0cef1faafc290ccc`, observed by successful `git ls-remote` and commit-pinned raw HTTP 200 snapshots. The four snapshots are exact files, not a full repository audit. License snapshot is MIT, copyright 2026 DeepSeek; only that snapshot was inspected for licensing. [Tools registry](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/5badb15009ae1756c3afe0ae0cef1faafc290ccc/packages/core/tools/src/index.ts), [schema](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/5badb15009ae1756c3afe0ae0cef1faafc290ccc/packages/core/tools/src/schema.ts), [terminal lifecycle](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/5badb15009ae1756c3afe0ae0cef1faafc290ccc/packages/terminal/terminal/src/index.ts), [license](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/5badb15009ae1756c3afe0ae0cef1faafc290ccc/LICENSE).

## Evidence and mapping

- DSH tools registry `index.ts` 1063–1086 checks registered output schema/render and positive finite declarative timeout. `restrict` 1097–1122 is scoped to a live Agent; `guard` 1136–1140 is layered. `schemas` 1260–1289 projects only name, description, parameters, optional deferLoading, detached from executor callbacks. `prepareExecution` 1493–1535 performs pre-execute/ask followed by a guard before dispatch. The schema module at 366 and 438–478 checks author keys and compiles/validates argument schemas. The `timeoutMs` registration check is not itself proof of runtime deadline enforcement.
- DSH terminal `index.ts` 154–215 reserves an unpublished spawn and publishes on successful backend setup; 243–260 serializes active send; 285–305 kills/waits for close; 318–387 binds exact in-process Agent owner and cleans pending spawns; 407–456 aborts and disposes sessions. This owner identity is process-local, unlike ResearchOS durable run/workspace identity. No terminal integration is recommended.
- ResearchOS Main `internal/domain/runtime_tools_windows.go` 14–52 already accepts only read/write/edit/run_check and validates arguments against the frozen `model_config.tools` JSON Schema locally. Lines 55–200 gate `mu_turn`, WorkspaceAuthority, profile tool policy, effect ledger, session/workspace/model binding, revalidation, and UNKNOWN/no auto-retry. `internal/host/runtime_tools_windows.go` 45–200 physically enforces workspace-root, read/write path and byte limits; write/edit require durable intent and revalidation.
- Mu Main `adapters/runtime/mu/worker.mjs` 415–430 checks a bounded frozen function list; 696–713 mediates TOOL protocol; 737–807 creates Pi SDK AgentSession with `noTools: builtin`, `customTools` from frozen config and no extension/skill loading. `package.json` contains local Pi dependencies. Pi is a Mu frozen-worker dependency, not a separate ResearchOS runner in this comparison. The existing cancel receipt pins a frozen worker bundle. Proposed v9 trial source 931–943 narrows read to `evidence.txt`, max one tool call, 4096 bytes, no write path; this is proposed source evidence, not a shipped qualification result.

## Smallest useful boundary

If a product experiment is later authorized, derive a deterministic model-visible schema projection from frozen `model_config.tools` and check that names, descriptions, parameters, and strictness stay in lockstep with the Go validator at worker initialization. Keep the existing Go authority, effect ledger, and host executor as the only dispatch. This is a local pure transformation/contract check; it should not import the DSH registry or use its terminal or approval lifecycle. DSH's exact implementation has `deferLoading` and a different tool-definition shape, so it is a pattern reference, not drop-in code.

This intake did not install the package, run a DSH agent or CLI, invoke a provider, mutate Main/canonical state, or verify the candidate end-to-end. The official GitHub REST commit URL failed in `web.open` (failure ordinal 713). `failure713.capture.json` preserves the available tool projection and states the missing raw HTTP/status layer; git and raw-content calls supplied the commit and source snapshots independently.

import {
  bigint,
  boolean,
  index,
  int,
  json,
  mysqlEnum,
  mysqlTable,
  primaryKey,
  uniqueIndex,
  varchar,
} from "drizzle-orm/mysql-core"
import { timestamps, ulid, utc, workspaceColumns } from "../drizzle/types"
import { workspaceIndexes } from "./workspace.sql"

export const BlackPlans = ["20", "100", "200"] as const
export const BillingTable = mysqlTable(
  "billing",
  {
    ...workspaceColumns,
    ...timestamps,
    customerID: varchar("customer_id", { length: 255 }),
    paymentMethodID: varchar("payment_method_id", { length: 255 }),
    paymentMethodType: varchar("payment_method_type", { length: 32 }),
    paymentMethodLast4: varchar("payment_method_last4", { length: 4 }),
    balance: bigint("balance", { mode: "number" }).notNull(),
    monthlyLimit: int("monthly_limit"),
    monthlyUsage: bigint("monthly_usage", { mode: "number" }),
    timeMonthlyUsageUpdated: utc("time_monthly_usage_updated"),
    reload: boolean("reload"),
    reloadTrigger: int("reload_trigger"),
    reloadAmount: int("reload_amount"),
    reloadError: varchar("reload_error", { length: 255 }),
    timeReloadError: utc("time_reload_error"),
    timeReloadLockedTill: utc("time_reload_locked_till"),
    subscription: json("subscription").$type<{
      status: "subscribed"
      seats: number
      plan: (typeof BlackPlans)[number]
      useBalance?: boolean
      coupon?: string
    }>(),
    subscriptionID: varchar("subscription_id", { length: 28 }),
    subscriptionPlan: mysqlEnum("subscription_plan", BlackPlans),
    timeSubscriptionBooked: utc("time_subscription_booked"),
    timeSubscriptionSelected: utc("time_subscription_selected"),
    liteSubscriptionID: varchar("lite_subscription_id", { length: 28 }),
    lite: json("lite").$type<{
      useBalance?: boolean
    }>(),
  },
  (table) => [
    ...workspaceIndexes(table),
    uniqueIndex("global_customer_id").on(table.customerID),
    uniqueIndex("global_subscription_id").on(table.subscriptionID),
    uniqueIndex("global_lite_subscription_id").on(table.liteSubscriptionID),
  ],
)

export const SubscriptionTable = mysqlTable(
  "subscription",
  {
    ...workspaceColumns,
    ...timestamps,
    userID: ulid("user_id").notNull(),
    rollingUsage: bigint("rolling_usage", { mode: "number" }),
    fixedUsage: bigint("fixed_usage", { mode: "number" }),
    timeRollingUpdated: utc("time_rolling_updated"),
    timeFixedUpdated: utc("time_fixed_updated"),
  },
  (table) => [...workspaceIndexes(table), uniqueIndex("workspace_user_id").on(table.workspaceID, table.userID)],
)

export const LiteTable = mysqlTable(
  "lite",
  {
    ...workspaceColumns,
    ...timestamps,
    userID: ulid("user_id").notNull(),
    rollingUsage: bigint("rolling_usage", { mode: "number" }),
    weeklyUsage: bigint("weekly_usage", { mode: "number" }),
    monthlyUsage: bigint("monthly_usage", { mode: "number" }),
    timeRollingUpdated: utc("time_rolling_updated"),
    timeWeeklyUpdated: utc("time_weekly_updated"),

import { Resource } from "@opencode-ai/console-resource"
import { and, Database, eq, isNotNull, isNull, sql } from "@opencode-ai/console-core/drizzle/index.js"
import { KeyTable } from "@opencode-ai/console-core/schema/key.sql.js"
import { ProviderTable } from "@opencode-ai/console-core/schema/provider.sql.js"
import { WorkspaceTable } from "@opencode-ai/console-core/schema/workspace.sql.js"

const paths: Record<string, string | undefined> = {
  "POST /zen/v1/chat/completions": "/openai/v1/chat/completions",
  "POST /zen/v1/responses": "/openai/v1/responses",
  "POST /zen/v1/messages": "/anthropic/v1/messages",
  "POST /zen/v1/systemone": "/systemone/v1/systemone",
  "POST /zen/go/v1/chat/completions": "/go/openai/v1/chat/completions",
  "POST /zen/go/v1/responses": "/go/openai/v1/responses",
  "POST /zen/go/v1/messages": "/go/anthropic/v1/messages",
  "POST /zen/go/v1/systemone": "/go/systemone/v1/systemone",
  "GET /zen/v1/models": "/v1/models",
  "GET /zen/go/v1/models": "/go/v1/models",
  "GET /zen/go/v1/usage": "/go/v1/usage",
}

export async function proxyInference(
  request: Request,
  generation?: {
    provider?: "openai" | "anthropic" | "google"
    /** The provider's native model ID, not the public Zen alias. */
    model?: string
    /** Forward keyless requests for this model anonymously instead of serving them here. */
    anonymous?: boolean
    body: (model?: string) => ReadableStream<Uint8Array>
  },
): Promise<Response | undefined> {
  const url = new URL(request.url)
  const path =
    paths[`${request.method} ${url.pathname}`] ??
    (request.method === "POST" &&
    /^\/zen\/v1\/models\/[^/]+:(?:generateContent|streamGenerateContent)$/.test(url.pathname)
      ? url.pathname.replace("/zen/v1/models/", "/google/v1beta/models/")
      : undefined)
  if (!path) return undefined

  const key = url.pathname.endsWith("/messages")
    ? request.headers.get("x-api-key")
    : path.startsWith("/google/")
      ? request.headers.get("x-goog-api-key")
      : request.headers.get("authorization")?.split(" ")[1]
  const anonymous = !key || key === "public"
  if (anonymous && !generation?.anonymous) return undefined

  // New Console keys are never in the legacy key table; every legacy key is `sk-`.
  const legacy = !anonymous && !key.startsWith("oc_sk_")
  const workspace = legacy ? await migratedWorkspace(key, generation?.provider) : undefined
  if (legacy && !workspace) return undefined
  const model = workspace?.provider ? generation?.model : undefined
  if (workspace?.provider && !model) throw new Error("Legacy BYOK model mapping is unavailable")

  const destination = new URL(Resource.ConsoleMigration.inferenceUrl)
  // Imported connections must use this same workspace/provider-derived ID.
  const target =
    model && workspace
      ? `/custom/conn_${workspace.id.slice(4)}_${workspace.provider}${
          path.startsWith("/google/")
            ? `/models/${encodeURIComponent(model)}${url.pathname.slice(url.pathname.lastIndexOf(":"))}`
            : url.pathname.slice("/zen/v1".length)
        }`
      : path
  destination.pathname = `${destination.pathname.replace(/\/$/, "")}${target}`
  destination.search = url.search
  destination.hash = ""

  // Model extraction has already read part of the body; forward its replay stream.
  const forwarded = new Request(
    destination,
    generation ? new Request(request, { method: request.method, body: generation.body(model) }) : request,
  )
  // Migrated requests use ordinary destination authentication and accounting.
  for (const name of [
    "x-zen",
    "x-zen-model",
    "x-zen-ip",
    "cf-access-client-id",
    "cf-access-client-secret",
    "host",
    "content-length",
  ])
    forwarded.headers.delete(name)
  // Keyless requests must reach new inference without credentials; `public` is not an API key there.
  if (anonymous) for (const name of ["authorization", "x-api-key", "x-goog-api-key"]) forwarded.headers.delete(name)
  if (!anonymous) forwarded.headers.set("authorization", `Bearer ${key}`)
  forwarded.headers.set("CF-Access-Client-Id", Resource.CLOUDFLARE_ACCESS_CLIENT_ID.value)
  const ip = request.headers.get("cf-connecting-ip")
  if (ip) forwarded.headers.set("x-zen-ip", ip)
  const requestID = request.headers.get("x-opencode-request-id") ?? request.headers.get("x-opencode-request")
  if (requestID) forwarded.headers.set("x-opencode-request-id", requestID)

  const response = await fetch(forwarded, { redirect: "manual" })
  // SolidStart replaces 404 responses with its own route-not-found body, hiding the inference error.
  if (response.status !== 404) return response
  return new Response(response.body, { status: 400, statusText: "Bad Request", headers: response.headers })
}

// Routing only; the destination owns authentication and revocation after cutover.
function migratedWorkspace(key: string, provider?: string) {
  return Database.use((tx) =>
    tx
      .select({ id: WorkspaceTable.id, provider: ProviderTable.provider })
      .from(KeyTable)
      .innerJoin(WorkspaceTable, eq(WorkspaceTable.id, KeyTable.workspaceID))
      .leftJoin(
        ProviderTable,
        provider
          ? and(
              eq(ProviderTable.workspaceID, KeyTable.workspaceID),
              eq(ProviderTable.provider, provider),
              isNull(ProviderTable.timeDeleted),
              sql`length(${ProviderTable.credentials}) > 0`,
            )
          : sql`false`,
      )
      .where(and(eq(KeyTable.key, key), isNotNull(WorkspaceTable.migrated_at)))
      .limit(1)
      .then((rows) => rows[0]),
  )
}

export function inferenceUnavailable() {
  return Response.json(
    { error: { type: "api_error", message: "Inference routing is unavailable. Please retry later." } },
    { status: 503, headers: { "Cache-Control": "no-store" } },
  )
}
